subject: Why is 15% of every payout being held now?
body:
Hi team,

I run Trailblazer Holiday Co. and I noticed starting late August that our payouts have dropped significantly compared to what our transaction volume actually was. I checked the dashboard and it looks like some kind of reserve has been applied but nobody told us about this directly, we just saw the numbers change.

We did have a rough patch in early August where a bunch of package tours got cancelled because of the flight disruptions in the north-east region, and a few customers went straight to their banks instead of asking us for refunds. I get that those chargebacks happened, but is this reserve going to be permanent now? How long is 15% of our money going to sit there and when do we actually see it again?

This is a big chunk of our working capital and we need to plan around it. Please explain clearly what triggered this and when it ends.

Regards,
Ankita (Trailblazer Holiday Co.)
